# Generated by mods/where_to_produce/tools/generate.py. Do not edit by hand.
#
# The region pickers. One list per continent, each row a region, one tick per
# row. Row labels are the game's own region keys handed to CMM as flags, so the
# names arrive translated in whatever language the player runs and nothing here
# has to carry a copy of them.
#
# Item ordinals are literals throughout: a CMM list macro pastes `item = var:x`
# verbatim and the load dies on it.
#
# Scope: country

# Scope: country
bag_wtp_register_zone_lists = {
	bag_wtp_register_zone_africa = yes
	bag_wtp_register_zone_asia = yes
	bag_wtp_register_zone_oceania = yes
	bag_wtp_register_zone_ocean_continent = yes
	bag_wtp_register_zone_america = yes
	bag_wtp_register_zone_europe = yes
}

# Collect the ticked regions of every list into one global list the ranking pass
# walks. `cmm_build_list_bool_list` clears the list it writes into, so each list
# is read into its own and they are merged here rather than appended.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_rebuild_zone = {
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_regions
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_region_count value = 0 }
	if = {
		# Registration may not have completed yet on the first pass.
		limit = { has_variable_list = cmm_list_items_bag_wtp__zone_africa }
		cmm_build_list_bool_list = { setting = bag_wtp__zone_africa field_slot = 1 list_name = bag_wtp_zone_africa }
		every_in_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_zone_africa
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_regions target = this }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_region_count add = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		# Registration may not have completed yet on the first pass.
		limit = { has_variable_list = cmm_list_items_bag_wtp__zone_asia }
		cmm_build_list_bool_list = { setting = bag_wtp__zone_asia field_slot = 1 list_name = bag_wtp_zone_asia }
		every_in_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_zone_asia
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_regions target = this }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_region_count add = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		# Registration may not have completed yet on the first pass.
		limit = { has_variable_list = cmm_list_items_bag_wtp__zone_oceania }
		cmm_build_list_bool_list = { setting = bag_wtp__zone_oceania field_slot = 1 list_name = bag_wtp_zone_oceania }
		every_in_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_zone_oceania
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_regions target = this }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_region_count add = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		# Registration may not have completed yet on the first pass.
		limit = { has_variable_list = cmm_list_items_bag_wtp__zone_ocean_continent }
		cmm_build_list_bool_list = { setting = bag_wtp__zone_ocean_continent field_slot = 1 list_name = bag_wtp_zone_ocean_continent }
		every_in_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_zone_ocean_continent
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_regions target = this }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_region_count add = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		# Registration may not have completed yet on the first pass.
		limit = { has_variable_list = cmm_list_items_bag_wtp__zone_america }
		cmm_build_list_bool_list = { setting = bag_wtp__zone_america field_slot = 1 list_name = bag_wtp_zone_america }
		every_in_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_zone_america
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_regions target = this }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_region_count add = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		# Registration may not have completed yet on the first pass.
		limit = { has_variable_list = cmm_list_items_bag_wtp__zone_europe }
		cmm_build_list_bool_list = { setting = bag_wtp__zone_europe field_slot = 1 list_name = bag_wtp_zone_europe }
		every_in_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_zone_europe
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_regions target = this }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_region_count add = 1 }
		}
	}
}
